[![PR](https://img.shields.io/badge/template-pull%20request-2563eb)](../CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Evidence

Include relevant tests, planner output, benchmark results, screenshots, or reproduction steps.

## Risk

What can fail? Does this affect memory estimation, remote execution, privacy, security, persisted formats, or backend compatibility?

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is narrowly scoped.
- [ ] Tests cover important behavior and failure paths.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] Performance claims follow `docs/BENCHMARKING.md`.
- [ ] No prompts, secrets, tokens, private model data, or private host details are committed.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes update the threat model when necessary.
- [ ] Commit messages use emoji + Czech/English summary.

## Related issues / decisions

Link issues and relevant ADR entries.
